caption: The drawing shows a silhouette of a galloping horse weather vane positioned centrally on a rectangular background. The horse is rendered in a dark brown color with visible rust-like texture, resembling aged metal. Its legs are extended, and its head is pointed upwards and slightly forward, with the tail streaming out behind. The horse is oriented to face the left side of the composition. Below the horse, there is text in capital letters that reads, "WEATHER-VANE 1/6 ACTUAL SIZE," with additional lighter text below that appears to say, "ELMER S. ANDERSON." The background surrounding the horse is a flat, muted beige or light tan color, and the entire artwork is bordered by a wider, off-white or cream-colored margin. The overall style is simple and direct, focusing on the representation of the horse and accompanying text without any additional elements or decoration.
title: Weather Vane
